# NDVI Small

A tiny single-band float32 NDVI-style derived product with values in the [-1, 1] range. Exercises derived-index raster handling.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Case ID | `ndvi_small` |
| Category | raster |
| Format | GeoTIFF |
| CRS | `EPSG:32633` |
| Test tier | integration |
| Size class | tiny |
| Storage class | bundled |
| Redistributable | yes |
| Loader | `rasterio` |
| Status | validated |

## Use this case

```python
import pytest


@pytest.mark.geocase_case("ndvi_small")
def test_ndvi_small(geocase_case) -> None:
    data = geocase_case.load()
    assert data is not None
```

## What this case checks

Confirm GeoCase can open an NDVI-style derived raster and preserve its single float32 band of values bounded in [-1, 1].

## Risk types covered

- [`dtype_drift`](../../risk/dtype-drift.md)
- [`value_range_violation`](../../risk/value-range-violation.md)

| Assertion | Expected |
|---|---|
| `expect_loadable` | yes |

| `expected_band_count` | `1` |
| `expected_dtype` | `float32` |
| `expected_shape` | `16`, `16` |
